No standalone Section XIII Main Notes table is present in this Chapter 68 PDF; section_notes array is therefore empty.

Chapter 68 Main Notes table contains 2 notes (Note 1 and Note 2). Note 1 is a chapter exclusion note listing items (a) through (n) that are not covered. Note 2 defines 'worked monumental or building stone' for heading 6802.

Source PDF Note 2 contains a transcription artifact: 'worked monumental or building stone' is rendered with double-doubled quotes ('""worked monumental or building stone""'). Preserved as a single set of double quotes in this JSON.
Source PDF Note 1 sub-clause sequence skips letter (j) (uses (i), (ij), (k)) — this is verbatim from the source. Sub-clauses extracted as separate exclusion_clauses entries.
Tariff codes in source PDF use no-dot format (NNNNNNNN). All 8-digit codes normalized to NNNN.NN.NN by inserting dots after positions 4 and 6.

Headings 6802, 6804, 6810, 6811, 6812, 6813, 6814, 6815 use the standard sub-heading layout where parent description lines (e.g. 'Other monumental or building stone and articles thereof, simply cut or sawn, with a flat or even surface : -- Marble, travertine and alabaster') appear as a sub-heading row followed by tariff lines.

Sub-heading 681410 is followed by tariff lines 68141010-68141090. Sub-heading 681490 (Other) is followed by 68149010-68149090. No 'parent' tariff-line code with all zeros exists for those sub-headings.

Heading 6815 description text 'Carbon fibres; articles of carbon fibres for non-electrical uses; other articles of graphite or other carbon for non-electrical uses: -- Carbon fibres' is split across two rows in the source PDF for tariff line 68151100 (text continues on next row 'other carbon for non-electrical uses: - - Carbon fibres'). Reassembled into the single tariff line description.
Tariff line 68159100 description begins 'Other articles :-' in source PDF (single hyphen); preserved verbatim.

Tariff lines 68118100, 68118200, 68138100, 68138900 are subheading-level 6-digit codes (681181, 681182, 681381, 681389) extended with '00'. Source PDF lists them under heading 6811 / 6813 without an explicit sub-heading title row; treated as sub-headings of heading 6811 and 6813 respectively.
Sub-heading 681189 ('Not containing asbestos : -- Other articles') appears as a sub-heading row with two tariff lines 68118910 and 68118990 in source.

Sub-heading 681320 ('Containing asbestos') has two tariff lines (68132010, 68132090). Sub-heading 681389 ('Not containing asbestos') has two tariff lines (68138100, 68138900) without an explicit sub-heading title row — treated as direct tariff lines under heading 6813.
All tariff lines display Export Policy 'Free' and have empty Policy Condition column. No policy_conditions, export_licensing_notes, or notification entries are present in this Chapter 68 PDF.

Asbestos note: Chapter 68 PDF does NOT contain explicit asbestos export restrictions / policy conditions in the visible Schedule 2 columns. All asbestos-related tariff lines (681140, 68114010, 68114020, 68114090, 6812, 681281, 68128000, 681291, 681299*, 681320, 68132010, 68132090, 68138100, 68138900) show Export Policy 'Free' with empty Policy Condition. policy_conditions array left empty.
Unit column is not provided in this source PDF; all tariff_lines.unit set to null.
Source PDF does not contain explicit Sub-Heading Notes or Supplementary Notes for Chapter 68; subheading_notes arrays are empty.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover : (a) goods of Chapter 25 ; (b) coated, impregnated or covered paper and paperboard of heading 4810 or 4811 (for example, paper and paperboard coated with mica powder or graphite, bituminised or asphalted paper and paperboard) ; (c) coated, impregnated or covered textile fabric of Chapter 56 or 59 (for example, fabric coated or covered with mica powder, bituminised or asphalted fabric) ; (d) articles of Chapter 71 ; (e) tools or parts of tools, of Chapter 82 ; (f) lithographic stones of heading 8442 ; (g) electrical insulators (heading 8546) or fittings of insulating material of heading 8547 ; (h) dental burrs (heading 9018) ; (ij) articles of Chapter 91 (for example, clocks and clock cases) (k) articles of Chapter 94 (for example, furniture, luminaires and lighting fittings, prefabricated buildings) ; (l) articles of Chapter 95 (for example, toys, games and sports requisites) ; (m) articles of heading 9602, if made of materials specified in Note 2 (b) to Chapter 96, or of heading 9606 (for example, buttons), of heading 9609 (for example, slate pencils), heading 9610 (for example, drawing slates) or of heading 9620 (monopods, bipods, tripods and similar articles); or; (n) articles of Chapter 97 (for example, works of art).

In heading 6802, the expression "worked monumental or building stone" applies not only to the varieties of stone referred to in heading 2512.5 or 2516 but also to all other natural stone (for example, quartzite, flint, dolomite and steatite) similarly worked; it does not, however, apply to slate.
